in_marathi.name: Mohanasundaram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon (Mohana) - Victory (Sundara) - Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohanasundaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Mohanasundaram is a combination of three Sanskrit words: 'Mohana' which means 'Moon', 'Sundara' which means 'Victory', and 'Rama' which is a name of God. This name is believed to signify the victory of the divine Rama over the moon, symbolizing the overcoming of distractions and focusing on the divine.

This name is believed to signify the victory of the divine Rama over the moon, symbolizing the overcoming of distractions and focusing on the divine.
